messages.subject: dynamic sliderInput
parts:
Hi everyone!

I would like to create dynamic sliderInput, dynamic in sense of changing color according to slider value.
For example: I have a value in slider from 0 to 20 and if the value is under 15, I would like slider to appear in red, otherwise in green.

Can you help me?

Regards,

Uros

messages.author: d6ebe55625e8e5a2
messages.subject: Re: dynamic sliderInput
parts:
Unfortunately, there is no easy, out-of-box way of doing this. Not even using JS directly to modify the underlying ion range slider library (see this thread: https://github.com/IonDen/ion.rangeSlider/issues/435). You have to create your own CSS and figure out a way of dynamically generating the sliderInput such that the correct CSS rules apply. In my opinion, the best way to accomplish this is to:

  1. Use uiOutput and renderUI to create the sliderInput dynamically on the server function.

  2. Use a div container to wrap the actual sliderInput -- this container should have a different class for each different color.

  3. Create the CSS rules. (Note: I inserted these directly into the shiny app, but since there's a lot of it, in your actual app, you should put all of that into an actual CSS file and then import that in your app).

See the example below that accomplishes what you describe.


library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$head(tags$style(
    "
    .red .irs-bar {
      border-top: 1px solid red !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid red !important;
      background: red !important;
    }
    .red .irs-single {
      background: red !important;
    }
    .red .irs-bar-edge {
      border: 1px solid red !important;
      background: red !important;
    }
    .red .irs-grid-pol {
      background: red !important;
    }
    .red .irs-grid-pol.small {
      background: #999 !important;
    }

    .green .irs-bar {
      border-top: 1px solid green !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid green !important;
      background: green !important;
    }
    .green .irs-single {
      background: green !important;
    }
    .green .irs-bar-edge {
      border: 1px solid green !important;
      background: green !important;
    }
    .green .irs-grid-pol {
      background: green !important;
    }
    .green .irs-grid-pol.small {
      background: #999 !important;
    }
    "
  )),
  uiOutput("ui")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$ui <- renderUI({
    # 10 is the starting value for the slider
    val <- if (!is.null(input$sld)) input$sld else 10
    
    # conditional logic
    container <- function(...) {
      if (val < 15) div(class = "red", ...)
      else div(class = "green", ...)
    }
    
    container(sliderInput("sld", "My slider", 0, 20, val))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
